title: Conflict resolution (knowledge/_conflicts/<CONF-id>.yaml)
description: A person's decision about two pieces of knowledge that contradict each other (T66). Only the decision is stored — the conflict itself is detected fresh on every run from the items, because a stored list of conflicts goes stale the moment somebody fixes one. `decided_by` is a person's name and not a role for a reason: the whole point of this record is that an agent did not decide it.

id.description: CONF-<hash>, derived from the conflicting ids and the kind of conflict, so the same conflict gets the same id on every run and a decision made last month still matches it.

conflict_kind.description: declared = somebody wrote a `conflicts-with` relation. The rest are detected: two records defining the same model, the same endpoint, or the same domain term.

items.description: The conflicting item ids, sorted. Stored as well as hashed into the id so the file is readable without re-running detection.

decision.description: What was decided, in a sentence. Free text on purpose: 'keep the first' is rarely the real answer, and an enum would push whoever writes this toward the nearest available option instead of the true one.

decided_by.description: The person who decided. A name, not a role — a resolution attributed to 'human' cannot be asked a follow-up question.
